# Nikola Tsolov Fan — nikolatsolovfan.com

> Independent English and Bulgarian fan site tracking Nikola Tsolov, the Bulgarian racing driver ("the Bulgarian Lion"), in the 2026 FIA Formula 2 Championship with Campos Racing (#6, Red Bull Junior Team). Live standings, race results, session schedules, and analysis of his path toward a 2027 Formula 1 seat.

Current status (after Round 9, Budapest, 26 July 2026): Tsolov leads the Drivers' Championship on 167 points, 20 clear of Gabriele Minì (147), with Rafael Câmara third (145). Six race wins in 2026. At Budapest he retired from the Sprint after contact with Sebastián Montoya (five-place grid penalty) and recovered from P12 to P7 in the Feature, which was won by his Campos teammate Noel León. Next round: Monza, 4–6 September 2026, after the summer break.

This is an unofficial fan site, not affiliated with Nikola Tsolov, Campos Racing, Red Bull, or the FIA. Facts are checked against official FIA Formula 2 results before publishing.

## Race analysis and news

- [Monza R10 preview: the season restarts, Tsolov 20 points clear](https://nikolatsolovfan.com/articles/r10-monza-tsolov-preview-2026/): Preview of Round 10 at Monza (4–6 September 2026) — Tsolov's F3 podium record at the circuit, why the low-downforce track races unlike Budapest, and the title math with five rounds left.
- [Budapest R09 analysis: Twelfth to seventh, a 20-point lead](https://nikolatsolovfan.com/articles/r09-budapest-tsolov-analysis-2026/): Tsolov recovers from a grid penalty (P12) to seventh in the Feature; teammate Noel León takes his first Feature win; the lead holds at 20 points into the summer break.
- [Spa R08 analysis: Third through the chaos, a 27-point halfway lead](https://nikolatsolovfan.com/articles/r08-spa-tsolov-analysis-2026/): Câmara wins; Tsolov recovers to third through a red-flag race after a gravel moment and a collapsing supersoft; León disqualified post-race.
- [Silverstone R07 analysis: the double win](https://nikolatsolovfan.com/articles/r07-silverstone-tsolov-analysis-2026/): Sprint and Feature wins, the first F2 double-win weekend since 2024, with an outside pass at Maggotts–Becketts.
- [Barcelona R05 analysis: P2 becomes P4 by penalty](https://nikolatsolovfan.com/articles/r05-barcelona-tsolov-analysis-2026/): recovery drive and a track-limits penalty.
- [Monaco R04 analysis: from −22 to −1](https://nikolatsolovfan.com/articles/r04-monaco-tsolov-analysis-2026/): the Feature win that reshaped the title fight.
